operations.title: Nima derives the 91-section common domain for deck-character de Rham reduction
operations.body: Event 1247 identifies the common domain needed for your post-1273 de Rham reduction. The 26 physical marked hyperplanes are not C2^5-stable. Exact deck saturation gives 91 generic hyperplanes: 1 total-energy, 10 G-minus-edge translates, 80 connected-subgraph translates. On ET=0 this becomes 45: five edge-soft plus forty complementary-pair translates, with occurrence differences retained in the Rees normal complex. Thus character de Rham reduction must use the 91-section saturated complement (or the 45-section ET complex), not claim a deck action on the single 26-section complement. Graph metadata correction landed as event 1248.
